review.editorial: Reviewed the full return scene and its transition from the previous ending; preserved the passage of a travel day and room for physical and emotional reactions.
review.continuity_or_facts: Checked the route, elapsed day, continuing injuries, possessions and explicit transfer of responsibility. Received information is distinguished from messages only sent.
review.english_alignment: Reviewed every sentence-local gloss and corrected contextual counting, rolling and complement readings deterministically. Saved-sentence selection contained one complete sentence with its own English guide; study units remain sentence-sized.
